QUOTE: "high = ret & 0xFF80 ──► mbedtls_high_level_strerr(ret) ... low = ret & ~0xFF80 ──► mbedtls_low_level_strerr(ret) ... high string written to buf; if low is non-zero, append \" : \" and the low string"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains the two-layer code (high-level module part and low-level part) and that mbedtls_strerror joins both strings with " : " when both are present.
